description_en: Queries instance refresh tasks in a scaling group, including basic information and progress of the tasks
description_zh: 如果您需要查看实例刷新任务的基本信息、 实例刷新任务的进度等信息，您可以调用DescribeInstanceRefreshes查询该伸缩组的实例刷新任务
kebab_example: aliyun ess describe-instance-refreshes --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --max-results 10 --scaling-group-id asg-bp1ffogfdauy0jw00000 --instance-refresh-task-ids ir-adfa1231200000 --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstanceRefreshes

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的NextToken参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page in a paging query. Valid values: 1 to 50.
Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页的最大条目数，取值范围：1~50。
默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the scaling group.
You must specify either ScalingGroupId or InstanceRefreshTaskIds. If you do not specify either parameter, an error is returned
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩组的ID。
调用该API时，ScalingGroupId和InstanceRefreshTaskIds参数必须二选一进行配置，如果两个参数同时都不配置，则会报错
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the instance refresh tasks that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 待查询实例刷新任务的 ID
parameters.name: instance_refresh_task_ids

InstanceRefreshTasks.description_en: The list of instance refresh tasks

CheckpointPauseTime.description_en: The pause duration when the task reaches a checkpoint. Unit: minutes
CheckpointPauseTime.description_zh: 当进入刷新任务检查点时，暂停的时长。单位：分钟

Checkpoints.description_en: The checkpoints for the refresh task. A checkpoint specifies that the task automatically pauses for CheckpointPauseTime minutes when the proportion of new instances reaches the specified value during the instance refresh
Checkpoints.description_zh: 刷新任务检查点：指定在实例刷新过程中，当新实例占比达到设定值时自动暂停任务CheckpointPauseTime分钟

items.description_en: The checkpoints for the refresh task. A checkpoint specifies that the task automatically pauses for CheckpointPauseTime minutes when the proportion of new instances reaches the specified value during the instance refresh
items.description_zh: 刷新任务检查点：指定在实例刷新过程中，当新实例占比达到设定值时自动暂停任务CheckpointPauseTime分钟

Percentage.description_en: The percentage of new instances relative to the total instances in the scaling group. The task automatically pauses when this percentage is reached
Percentage.description_zh: 伸缩组中新实例占总实例的占比，到达该占比时任务自动暂停

DesiredConfiguration.description_en: The desired configuration for the instance refresh

Containers.description_en: The list of containers in the instance

items.description_en: The list of containers in the instance

Args.description_en: The arguments for the container startup commands
Args.description_zh: 容器启动命令对应的参数

items.description_en: The arguments for the container startup commands
items.description_zh: 容器启动命令对应的参数

FieldRefFieldPath.description_en: This parameter is not available for use

Key.description_en: The name of the environment variable

Value.description_en: The value of the environment variable

ImageId.description_en: The ID of the image file used for automatic creation of instances
ImageId.description_zh: 镜像文件ID，自动创建实例时使用的镜像资源

LaunchTemplateId.description_en: The ID of the launch template from which the scaling group obtains launch configuration information
LaunchTemplateId.description_zh: 实例启动模板的 ID，用于指定伸缩组从实例启动模板获取启动配置信息

LaunchTemplateOverrides.description_en: The instance type information that overrides the launch template
LaunchTemplateOverrides.description_zh: 扩展启动模板的实例规格信息

items.description_en: The instance type information that overrides the launch template
items.description_zh: 扩展启动模板的实例规格信息

InstanceType.description_en: The instance type that overrides the instance type specified in the launch template
InstanceType.description_zh: 指定的实例规格，会覆盖启动模板中的实例规格

LaunchTemplateVersion.description_en:
The version of the launch template. Valid values:

A fixed template version number.
Default: always uses the default version of the template.
Latest: always uses the latest version of the template
LaunchTemplateVersion.description_zh:
实例启动模板的版本。可能值：

固定的模板版本号。
Default：始终使用模板默认版本。
Latest：始终使用模板最新版本

ScalingConfigurationId.description_en: The ID of the scaling configuration

Detail.description_en: The failure reason when the instance refresh task fails
Detail.description_zh: 实例刷新任务执行失败时，具体的失败原因
Detail.example: The task exceeded its maximum run time of one week. So the task failed.

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the instance refresh task
EndTime.description_zh: 实例刷新任务的结束时间

FinishedUpdateCapacity.description_en: The capacity that has been refreshed

InstanceRefreshTaskId.description_en: The ID of the instance refresh task

MaxHealthyPercentage.description_en: The maximum percentage by which the number of instances in the scaling group can exceed the scaling group capacity during the instance refresh
MaxHealthyPercentage.description_zh: 实例刷新期间，伸缩组中实例数量可以超出伸缩组容量的比例

MinHealthyPercentage.description_en: The minimum percentage of instances that must remain in service in the scaling group during the instance refresh
MinHealthyPercentage.description_zh: 实例刷新期间，伸缩组中保持正常提供服务实例数量占伸缩组容量的比例

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the scaling group

ScalingGroupId.description_en: The ID of the scaling group

SkipMatching.description_en:
Indicates whether instances that already match the desired configuration are skipped.

The system determines whether an instance matches based on the ID of the desired scaling configuration, not by comparing individual configuration items.

Valid values:

true: Skipped. When the instance refresh task starts, the system checks the configuration of each instance. Instances that were already created with the desired configuration are not refreshed.
false: Not skipped. After the instance refresh task starts, all instances in the scaling group are refreshed
SkipMatching.description_zh:
是否跳过和期望配置匹配的实例。

系统会根据期望伸缩配置的ID界定是否匹配，不会对比具体的配置项。

可能值：

true：跳过。当启动实例刷新任务时，系统会检查每个实例的配置。对于已经使用期望配置创建的实例，不执行刷新操作。
false：不跳过。在启动实例刷新任务后，刷新任务启动时所有伸缩组中的实例

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the instance refresh task
StartTime.description_zh: 实例刷新任务的开始时间

Status.description_en:
The current status of the instance refresh task. Valid values:
Pending: The instance refresh task is created and waiting to be scheduled.
InProgress: The instance refresh task is in progress.
Paused: The instance refresh task is paused.
CheckpointPause: The instance refresh task is paused because the task progress reached a checkpoint (`Checkpoint.Percentage`).
Failed: The instance refresh task failed.
Successful: The instance refresh task succeeded.
Cancelling: The instance refresh task is being cancelled.
Cancelled: The instance refresh task is cancelled.
RollbackInProgress: The instance refresh task is being rolled back.
RollbackSuccessful: The instance refresh task is rolled back.
RollbackFailed: The rollback of the instance refresh task failed
Status.description_zh:
实例刷新任务当前的状态，可能值：
Pending： 实例刷新任务创建成功，等待调度；
InProgress：实例刷新任务正在处理中；
Paused: 实例刷新任务处于暂停中；
CheckpointPause：因任务进度到达刷新任务检查点（`Checkpoint.Percentage`）而处于暂停状态；
Failed：实例刷新任务执行失败；
Successful：实例刷新任务执行成功；
Cancelling：实例刷新任务取消中；
Cancelled: 实例刷新任务取消完成；
RollbackInProgress：实例刷新任务回滚中；
RollbackSuccessful：实例刷新任务回滚成功；
RollbackFailed: 实例刷新任务回滚失败；

Strategy.description_en:
The execution strategy of the instance refresh task. Valid values:

Rolling: The instance refresh task creates new instances and releases old instances to perform the refresh.

ReplaceSystemDisk: The instance refresh task replaces the system cloud disk on existing instances
Strategy.description_zh:
实例刷新任务的运行策略，可能值：

Rolling：实例刷新任务通过创建新实例，释放旧实例的方式进行实例刷新。

ReplaceSystemDisk：在原有实例基础上更新系统盘

TotalNeedUpdateCapacity.description_en: The total capacity that needs to be refreshed
TotalNeedUpdateCapacity.description_zh: 一共需要完成刷新的容量

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page
MaxResults.description_zh: 单页查询的最大条目数

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next query. If NextToken is empty, no more results exist
NextToken.description_zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of instance refresh tasks
